card.preparation: SHA-256, 64-bit pHash (32x32 DCT) and dHash (9x8) per image; Train pairs linked when pHash and dHash distances are both within the chosen thresholds; connected components give source_group.
card.threshold_reason: pHash <= 4 keeps same-label share >= 0.989 and sampled pairs were mostly the same capture or adjacent frames; pHash 0-2 pairs with dHash > 16 (155 of 501) looked like different scenes, so DHASH_MAX = 16. pHash 6 adds 76 mixed-label groups and 8 chains a 3,950-image group.
card.test_use: Hashes and nearest-Train distance only, descriptive; no fitting.
